title: 1st Anniversary
message:
Hello dallu,
You must be opening after 260 days after i made this page and since its our 1 year anniversary we must be opening or seeing this together well it took a while to make this page (Not that i made it all alone by myself I used AI obviously) and I made this because I was missing you smmmm because you went to mamala and this idea hit me "what if we make time capsules which we can open later on" and then i had that birthday website so i used that idea to create this page too and we have our own personal diaries too i don't think we might have used it much tho but still i think by the time we open this we will at least write few things there.

Keeping those things aside congratulations to us for keeping our promises and staying beside each other for 1 whole year i was so desperate for this day to arrive I hope i was able to keep all my promises and keep you happy and I hope that you still think of me as the best boyfriend and i am still nice to you if not well i will use this as reminder and be nice again though i doubt i can ever be mean to you since i love you smmmm babyyy and I wont write too much since this is our first anniversary i am sure i am writing a lots of things for you so lets keep this short
Happy 1 year dallu lets keep loving each other and move further (marry me)
